title: Why Fiber Laser Marking Beats Inkjet Coding for Permanent Metal Marking
excerpt: Inkjet coders have served Indian manufacturers for decades, but on metal surfaces they fall short — smearing, fading, and adding recurring ink costs. Fiber laser marking offers a permanent, maintenance-light alternative that pays for itself faster than most plant engineers expect. Here is what the numbers and the shop floor reality actually look like.
